summary: Flames bent on borrowed embers opaque passion passing in swirling patterns of fallen ash Lost truths now lit smoke curdles and claims moments of reality fleeting into yesterday's future #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Flames bent
   on borrowed
     embers
opaque
passion
  passing in
swirling patterns
of fallen ash

Lost truths
  now lit
smoke curdles
and claims
moments of reality
fleeting into
    yesterday's
future
#smallpoems
